critical_code_review_comments: routes/meals.py bulk-loads attendance + users with 5000 caps — matches dashboard pattern but will silently truncate if org grows past that. Consider pagination or explicit warning.
routes/meals.py: `_parse_hm` allows values that pass isinstance checks but rejects None with an AttributeError→400; add explicit None handling for clarity.

ChefsView.jsx date-picker default is `new Date().toLocaleDateString('sv-SE')` (browser-local), while the backend defaults to office-local (IST). At UTC-boundary hours, the two could disagree by one day — minor UX issue; consider deriving `today` from the initial response payload.
ChefsView.jsx `load()` has no in-flight guard — rapid Refresh clicks could race two requests; harmless but wasteful.

ChefsView.jsx: `data?.categories` is used for rendering but `TICKET_STYLE`/`CATEGORY_BADGE` maps are hardcoded to colors. If master seed adds a color not in the map, tile silently falls back to slate. Add a lint/console.warn for unknown colors.

meals.py sort of members happens after the loop but the same categories collection is fetched twice per request (once via /masters/categories caller, once inline). Fine for now; consider caching if it becomes a hot path.
